content.text:
I'd go with a Pesagot securities account (פסגות ניירות ערך), buy the "ילין לפידות מחקה (4D) S&P 500" fund and put in 750 ₪ every month. After 15 years the page says about **179,889 ₪ "בכסף של היום"**. I put in 135,000 ₪, so that's about 45,000 ₪ more than I deposited. I'm fairly sure.

**What decided it:** the page marks that pair "הבחירה שלכם · ★ הזול", and both names are ones I know. The next pair down, also Pesagot, ends only 122 ₪ lower, so the choice barely matters.

**Inflation:** the page assumes 2% a year. I only found that by tapping the grey "אינפלציה" button. A small window opened showing "אינפלציה בשנה 2%", described as "בכמה המחירים עולים בשנה, בממוצע". The return is set to 7% a year by default. I left both as they were.

**How it went:**
- **Top of the page:** the heading "איפה ואיך הכי זול להשקיע במדד" is exactly what I wanted, and S&P 500 was already picked. I changed the fields to 0 at the start, 750 a month and 15 years. The deposit total came out to 135,000 ₪, which matched.
- **Scrolling down:** I saw "כמה זה עולה לכם ב־15 שנים" with about 18,299 ₪ in costs. Going by the legend colour, most of that pink bar (15,364) is "מס". That scared me a bit, but at least it's in shekels, so I took it seriously.
- **The pick:** the account box says Pesagot costs 2,604 ₪ over the 15 years. The fund shows "דמי ניהול 0%".

**What I skipped:** the list of funds with all the tags (צוברת, עסקת החלף, מנוטרלת מט״ח and so on), the "כל החשבונות" text, and everything below that.

**Words I didn't get:** "דמי משמרת", "נאמן 0.02%", "עסקת החלף", "צוברת", "מנוטרלת מט״ח", "אם הדולר לא זז מול השקל".

**What bothered me:**
- After I typed 750, the slider sat on 800. For a moment I didn't know which number the page was using.
- When I changed the first field, part of the screen jumped sideways.
- The inflation assumption is hidden behind a button and isn't written next to the big result.
